title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 1 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt:
Living in a country where you have to speak a foreign language can cause serious social problems, as well as practical problems.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
scenario: Living in a country where you have to speak a foreign language can cause serious social problems, as well as practical problems.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
